author: (Poey, 1868)

note.en: A 3.5 cm red clingfish that lives among the spines of Echinometra sea urchins for protection; here known only from one 1968 museum specimen at Isla Uvita.
note.es: Un chupapiedra rojo de 3,5 cm que vive entre las espinas de erizos Echinometra para protegerse; aquí solo se conoce un espécimen de museo de 1968 en Isla Uvita.

evidence: OBIS: 1 records in the region (mostly museum specimens)

sources.t: OBIS and GBIF museum records (UCR Zoology Museum, LACM) from Limón, Isla Uvita, Cahuita and Puerto Viejo
